note: Pick-the-correct-spelling items for rules that cannot be heard (FLOSS, ck/qu/wh/ph, silent kn/wr/mb). Every word has Word Mapper audio. wrong = misspellings that sound the same and are not normal English words. cat = answer category used to balance questions. A group with choices is a sound-choice group (-ed: /t/, /d/, /ɪd/): the word is shown, the options are the choices and the answer is the cat of the item; hi = [start, length] of the letters to mark; silent = no audio before answering (the student applies the rule).
